evidence.text: Reason for referral: Evaluation of chest pressure with exertion.

Findings: Sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes at 64 bpm. Normal axis.
PR interval 166 ms, QRS 97 ms, QTc 451 ms.
Impression: Sinus rhythm with occasionaI premature atrial complexes and no acute changes.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
65%. Grade 1 diastolic dysfunction. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Normal left ventricular systolic function.
